title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 18: the power of the tongue, Yahweh's strong tower, and true friendship.

questions.text: According to this chapter, what does a fool delight in instead of understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:2 says a fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

questions.text: What are the words of a man's mouth compared to in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:4 says the words of a man's mouth are like deep waters, and the fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

questions.text: What are the words of a gossip compared to?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:8 says the words of a gossip are like dainty morsels that go down into a person's innermost parts.

questions.text: What does this chapter call a strong tower that the righteous run to?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:10 says Yahweh's name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

questions.text: Before honor there is what, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:12 says before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

questions.text: What does this chapter say about the one who answers before he hears?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:13 says he who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

answers.text: It is folly and shame to him

questions.text: He who pleads his cause first seems right, until what happens?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:17 says he who pleads his cause first seems right, until another comes and questions him.

questions.text: What does this chapter say is in the power of the tongue?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:21 says death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

questions.text: According to this chapter, what does the man who finds a wife find?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:22 says whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.

answers.text: A good thing, and favor of Yahweh
House and riches from his fathers
A continual feast in his house
A crown of glory for his head

questions.text: The last verse says there is a friend who sticks closer than whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 18:24 says a man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
